# doc-metadata-enricher

Extract title, author, date, language and email, URL and date entities from text, Markdown and HTML with explicit provenance per field and bounded input. Python package `doc_metadata_enricher` (import name `doc_metadata_enricher`), MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, zero dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): precedence model and API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test suite structure and coverage policies
